searchText: heya, Q: is there an equilibrium for staked eth? whats the number? and what are the forces at play to make this happen? that depends on a bunch of external macroeconomic factors rly? can u expand? well the interest rate you get from staking a unit of eth is inversely proportional to the total amount staked, which means there is *some* equilibrium there, but it's dependent on what the ROI you can expect from all other possible investments one can make, discounted by their perceived levels of risk that's assuming perfect efficiency too, some people intentionally make economically-irrational decisions due to unique external factors
